escalations.title: handlebars (transitive) — 8 CVEs: template injection, XSS, prototype pollution
escalations.exploit_scenario: If any route passes user-controlled data through a handlebars template, an attacker can inject template expressions triggering arbitrary JavaScript execution on the server (prototype pollution → RCE) or reflected XSS in the response.
escalations.impact: Remote code execution, reflected XSS, prototype pollution of Node.js runtime.
escalations.remediation: Run `npm audit --fix` in Source/Backend. Verify upgraded version resolves all 8 CVEs. TheGuardians to audit all handlebars usage paths.

escalations.title: vitest (direct) — arbitrary file read + code execution in dev/CI server
escalations.exploit_scenario: When the vitest UI server is running in dev or CI bound to 0.0.0.0, an unauthenticated attacker on the network can read arbitrary files and execute code in the server process.
escalations.impact: Arbitrary file read exposes secrets and source. Code execution = full server compromise. Risk elevated for CI runners with broad network access.
escalations.remediation: Run `npm update vitest` in Source/Frontend immediately. Never run vitest UI server bound to 0.0.0.0 in CI. TheGuardians to verify CI configuration and secret exposure.

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer scans Plans/ only — Specifications/ entirely bypassed
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: CI reports TRACEABILITY PASSED even though zero source comments reference Specifications/. Any engineer can ship code with no linkage to domain requirements without triggering a gate failure.
p1_findings.impact: Entire spec-first development discipline is structurally unenforced. PRs cannot be verified for traceability to domain requirements.
p1_findings.remediation: Extend traceability-enforcer.py to scan Specifications/*.md files. Add FR-ID tables to domain specs. Redirect // Verifies: comments to spec-based IDs.

p1_findings.title: All source FR comments trace to Plans/self-judging-workflow, not Specifications/ documents
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Engineers assume Plans/ traceability satisfies the architecture rule. Specifications/workflow-engine.md has no FR-ID table. Specs and source operate in disconnected universes.
p1_findings.impact: Domain specifications do not govern what gets built. Plans govern instead.
p1_findings.remediation: Add FR-ID tables to Specifications/workflow-engine.md. Migrate // Verifies: comments to reference spec-IDs. Run requirements-reviewer against both documents.

p1_findings.title: 69 domain requirements (FR-001→FR-069) have zero source coverage
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Stakeholders reading Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md believe 69 features exist. None do. Source/ builds a different product entirely.
p1_findings.impact: 100% spec gap on this document. Planning decisions based on these specs are invalid.
p1_findings.remediation: Hold spec review: deprecate Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md (mark DRAFT/ABANDONED) or create implementation tickets for all 69 requirements.

p2_findings.title: 10 FR-TMP-* requirements unimplemented (tiered merge pipeline)
p2_findings.details: Auto-PR, AI review, risk classification, auto-merge — all specified, none built.
p2_findings.remediation: Add to feature backlog with a priority decision. Requirements-reviewer to confirm scope.

p2_findings.title: pending_dependencies status missing from WorkItemStatus enum — returns HTTP 400 instead of state transition
p2_findings.details: Spec requires transitioning to pending_dependencies status on blocked dispatch. Code returns HTTP 400. The pending_dependencies value is missing from the WorkItemStatus enum entirely.
p2_findings.remediation: Add `pending_dependencies` to WorkItemStatus enum. Implement state transition in dispatch handler per spec.

p2_findings.title: 2 eslint-disable suppressions with no rationale comment
p2_findings.details: Violates the never swallow silently architecture rule. Each suppression needs an inline comment explaining why the lint rule is disabled.
p2_findings.remediation: Add rationale comments to each eslint-disable-next-line suppression.
